hub.releaseNotes:
Ordrili 1.6.11
- Subscription & add-ons: see your plan and renew from the app (Subscription page, invoices, BaridiMob / Algérie Poste payments with proof upload). New: tap-to-apply offers in the cart, and "until my subscription ends" now priced at the rate of the time left.
- Payments: payment records with history, edit/void, refunds; take payment on earlier days' unpaid orders.
- Kitchen printing: printer or tablet kitchen mode, ticket text size, printing station on phones.
- Spot: finds the Hub again after its network address changes; clear reconnect screen (Try again / Find the server / Reset) instead of an endless spinner. New: an open kiosk, tablet or board goes to that screen as soon as the Hub disappears, and the Connect screen shows the server's real, live status.
- Hub: pairing another restaurant starts clean, and asks first if unsent changes would be lost.
- Tables: free again each new service day — the kiosk no longer shows tables taken by yesterday's orders.
- Offline mode: calm "Offline mode" indicator when the internet drops — no reload prompts while the Hub keeps serving.
- Windows Hub: discoverable on the network like on Mac.
- New: switches next to an ⓘ tip (like a variant group's Required) are clickable again, and shared variant groups show the same ⓘ tips.
- Everyday polish: Tables and New Order layouts, boxed codes, How-To guide, menu photo cropping, a quieter "Catch not active" note, and many fixes.
